card.summary: Free downloads for everyone, with no published byte cap: 'Free downloads for everyone. Unlock uncapped speeds with Pro.'

record.category: premium file host (one-click hoster), retrieval target

free_tier.stated: Free downloads for everyone, with no published byte cap: 'Free downloads for everyone. Unlock uncapped speeds with Pro.'

per_object_cap.stated: 'Up to 100 GB per file' with a registered account

retention.stated: not stated on the landing page

egress.terms: 'Unlimited bandwidth' on the landing page; Pro adds 'Max speed', 'No wait', 'No ads'. Free is 'uncapped speeds' only after paying, so free is speed-shaped.

record.interface_detail: No API documentation found; the site is a single-page uploader with a Pro checkout.
record.tooling: browser drag-and-drop; no download-manager documentation found
record.chaining: The cheapest flat-rate key found in the sector. It is worth nothing at 1 TiB/month unless the files are UploadHaven-hosted, and its file network is the smallest of any host here.

limits.value: free tier is speed-capped; Pro is 'Max speed' with no number published
100 GB per file, registered account required
free downloads are shaped and gated; Pro removes the gate and the shaping, with no byte number published

record.limits_note: 'Unlimited bandwidth' has no fair-use clause found; that is an absence of evidence, not evidence of absence.
record.binding_note: With no byte cap published and no API, the thing that fails at 1 TiB/month is throughput or coverage long before any counter.

identity_cost.detail: E-mail signup for Pro; card payment.

record.reliability_note: Free downloads exist but are the tier the vendor is selling out of; no rate was measured on 2026-10-23.
record.confidence_note: Price and claim are from the vendor landing page read. The absence of a cap is unverified by measurement, so the record keeps no per-TiB confidence beyond the price.

evidence.proved: 'Up to 100 GB per file', 'Unlimited bandwidth', 'Free downloads for everyone. Unlock uncapped speeds with Pro.', 'Pro Plan ... Max speed, No wait, No ads', '$2.99 / 3 days or $8.99/month'
Pro is USD 8.99/month or USD 2.99/3 days, sold on 'Unlimited bandwidth', 'Max speed', 'No wait' and 'No ads'; no monthly byte allowance and no fair-use clause appear on the page.

record.price_per_tb_month: USD 8.99 per TiB-month on the stated 'Unlimited bandwidth', which no fair-use number contradicts that was reachable
record.notes: A plan with no allowance goes in the flat-month group, where it is USD 8.99/month and out of contention.
